title: JM Probable NDE 4527
content: I had a Pneumo Thorax and required surgery to fix it. Whilst undergoing surgery I had an experience, at which point I am not sure. I was not aware of leaving my body, but I was aware of 'waking up' somewhere else. I found myself in a small clearing in what seemed to be a kind of forest. There was a table in the clearing large and oval at which sat people who I did not know. I was beckoned to go and sit down at an empty space. After I sat down a large screen appeared behind the table and we all turned to see it. The screen showed in a fast forward mode all the events of my life up until that point. After the 'film' finished, there was a lot of discussion (which I did not really seem to be part of) about whether I had 'followed' my life path and overcome the tasks set to me. After some debate the consensus was that I had not and I was informed that I was to be 'sent' back for another try. This time, I would need to make some changes and put my life on a different track. I was escorted by one of the members of the 'council' out of the clearing to an area, which was quite non-descript in appearance, like being surrounded in a kind of mist. The mist grew more intense until I dissolved into it. The next thing I was aware of was waking up in the recovery room. As soon as I could speak, I reported to my attending nurse what had happened. It was logged on my chart as a dream.

arrival.other_being_detail: A group of unknown people described as a 'council' seated at a large oval table; one member escorted the experiencer.

environment.environment_other_detail: Small clearing in a forest; large oval table; a large screen appeared behind the table; later an area described as non-descript and surrounded by mist.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Informed by the 'council' that the consensus was he had not followed his life path/overcome tasks and was to be 'sent' back for another try, needing to make changes and put life on a different track.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Escorted into a misty, non-descript area; the mist intensified until he 'dissolved into it'; then he became aware of waking up in the recovery room.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Needed to make changes and put life on a different track.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Council-like deliberation about whether he had followed his life path and overcome tasks; screen showing life events in fast forward; dissolving into mist before waking in recovery room.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No explicit OBE or tunnel; begins with 'waking up' in a forest clearing, then life review on a screen, then council judgment and being sent back via mist, then waking in recovery.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review presented as a 'fast forward' film on a large screen behind an oval table, with a council debating whether the experiencer followed a life path and completed tasks; return described as dissolving into mist.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was not aware of leaving my body, but I was aware of 'waking up' somewhere else.”
